result.instructions: Tools for Oneflow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contracts in our workspace are still waiting for signatures?"; "Show me the parties and signing status of contract 10015."; "Create a draft contract from our NDA template in the Sales workspace.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Oneflow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run oneflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oneflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oneflow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. oneflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oneflow_get_account
tools.title: Get account information
tools.description: Get information about the connected Oneflow account (name, country, logo and similar). Oneflow API: GET /accounts/me.

tools.name: oneflow_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of the Oneflow account, with their ids, names, emails and active state. Use an email from here as user_email for other tools. Oneflow API: GET /users.

active.description: true = only active users, false = only inactive users.

tools.name: oneflow_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces the acting user can see. Workspace ids are needed to create contracts. Oneflow API: GET /workspaces.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List folders with their workspaces. Folder ids can be passed to oneflow_create_contract. Oneflow API: GET /folders.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List contract templates available to the acting user. Template ids are needed to create contracts. Oneflow API: GET /templates.

template_type_id.description: Only templates of this template type id.

active.description: true = only active templates, false = only inactive.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of the account. Tag ids can be passed to oneflow_create_contract. Oneflow API: GET /tags.

tools.name: oneflow_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List contracts, filterable by state, workspace, folder, template, tag, or a free-text query. Use it to find a contract id before the other contract tools. Oneflow API: GET /contracts.

sort.description: Sort key, for example -state,name (a leading - means descending).

query.description: Free-text search over contract names and data.

states.description: Comma-separated contract states, for example draft,uploaded,published,signed.

canceled.description: true = only canceled contracts, false = only the others.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_get_contract
tools.title: Get a contract
tools.description: Get one contract by id: name, state, workspace, folder, tags and timestamps. Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_contract_parties
tools.title: List contract parties
tools.description: List the parties (counterparties and the owner side) of a contract, with their participants. Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}/parties.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_get_contract_participant
tools.title: Get a contract participant
tools.description: Get one participant of a party in a contract (name, email, signing state). Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}/parties/{party_id}/participants/{participant_id}.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_contract_data_fields
tools.title: List contract data fields
tools.description: List the data fields of a contract with their custom ids and current values (for example dates, prices, names). Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}/data_fields.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_contract_files
tools.title: List contract files
tools.description: List the files of a contract: the contract PDF, verification, attachments. Returns metadata and ids, not file contents. Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}/files.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_list_contract_comments
tools.title: List contract comments
tools.description: List the comments on a contract. Oneflow requires an acting user for this call, so user_email (or ONEFLOW_USER_EMAIL) must be set. Oneflow API: GET /contracts/{contract_id}/comments.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_create_contract
tools.title: Create a draft contract
tools.description: Create a DRAFT contract from a template in a workspace. It does not publish the contract, so nobody is sent a link to sign. Needs workspace_id and template_id (from oneflow_list_workspaces and oneflow_list_templates). Oneflow API: POST /contracts/create.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id for the new contract.

template_id.description: Template id to create the contract from.

data_fields.description: Data field values, each { custom_id, value } using the template's custom ids.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_update_contract_data_fields
tools.title: Update contract data fields
tools.description: Set the values of one or more data fields on a contract. Many fields can only change before the contract is signed. Oneflow API: PUT /contracts/{contract_id}/data_fields.

custom_id.description: Data field custom id, when no id is known.

data_fields.description: Data fields to set. Each needs id or custom_id.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

tools.name: oneflow_create_contract_comment
tools.title: Add a contract comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a contract, optionally as a reply to parent_id. Oneflow API: POST /contracts/{contract_id}/comments.

user_email.description: Acting user's email (X-Oneflow-User-Email). Defaults to the account's configured user.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Oneflow
prompts.description: What you can do with Oneflow here, with example requests to try.
